author: garrick_zhang

commands.title: Quick Git Commit

commands.description: Select a repository and generate AI commit messages

commands.name: manage-repositories
commands.title: Manage Repositories
commands.subtitle: Auto Git Commit

preferences.name: commitStyle
preferences.title: Commit Style
preferences.description: Style of commit messages to generate

preferences.name: customInstructions
preferences.title: Custom AI Instructions
preferences.description: Additional instructions for AI commit message generation (optional)

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.
